AI researcher warns of superhuman systems by 2027

An AI researcher from Anthropic has called for a slowdown in artificial intelligence development, warning that the emergence of superhuman AI systems could lead to widespread joblessness. The researcher suggested that such advanced AI might arrive as early as late 2027.
